spans.s:
Bidala-kārī, ‘female splitter of bamboos,’ is the name of one of the victims at the Puruṣamedha (‘human sacrifice’) in the yajurveda. Eggeling renders the word as ‘basket-maker.’
Foot notes Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxx. 8; bidalakāra, taittirīya brāhmaṇa, iii. 4, 5, 1.
Sacred Books of the East, 44, 414.
